assertions: task-54: CONFIRMED — BPF LSM verifier rejection on kernel 7.1.3-2-cachyos resolved. Three fixes applied: (1) selector copy loop replaced with fixed-size __builtin_memcpy (eliminates 256-iteration branch-tree state explosion); (2) prior_ret and deny_errno clamped to [-4095,0] (verifier LSM return-value bound); (3) socket_connect addrlen bounded via power-of-2 bitmask (verifier-native bounds tracking).

BPF LSM program loads successfully: bpftool prog load type lsm accepted lsm.bpf.o (lsm_file_open: xlated 28152B, jited 16991B, 5 maps). All 3 hooks (file_open, bprm_check_security, socket_connect) attached via libbpf bpf_program__attach.
Deny mode verified: policy mode=1 with selector 'lsm_deny_test_target' and deny_errno=-13 — open() returned EACCES (errno=13). Own-denial attribution path exercised.
Kill-switch verified: deny_disabled=1 suppressed the deny decision — open() succeeded despite deny-mode policy. Kill-switch override path exercised.
Audit mode verified: policy mode=0 with matching selector — open() succeeded (audit-only, syscall result unchanged). Audit-first invariant preserved.

Semantic behavior unchanged: audit-first (mode=0 never denies), own-denial attribution (OWN_LSM only on deny path), prior-ret preservation (nonzero ret returned unchanged with clamp for verifier), fail-open on unknown context. Selector copy preserved (full 256-byte memcpy from zero-initialized stack buffer is semantically identical to the prior memset+conditional-loop).
No BPF programs left pinned after testing: /sys/fs/bpf/lsm_test removed; harness links fd-bound and destroyed on process exit.

environment.os_release: CachyOS (host kernel; suite executed inside a privileged fedora:latest Docker container with bpffs, debugfs, and securityfs bind-mounted)

fixes_applied.issue: 256-iteration conditional byte-copy loop in emit_decision() exploded verifier state count (each iteration doubled explored states via the i < bounded_len branch)
fixes_applied.fix: Replaced memset + conditional loop with unconditional __builtin_memcpy(ev->payload.selector, sel_buf, 256). Semantically identical: sel_buf is always zero-initialized by callers, so bytes beyond the meaningful prefix are zeros. Clang lowers to ~32 load/store pairs (no branches).
fixes_applied.verifier_before: processed 8764+ insns, state explosion at loop iterations 197-256 (refs=152+)

fixes_applied.issue: LSM hook return values (prior_ret passthrough, deny_errno from map) not provably in [-4095, 0]
fixes_applied.fix: Added clamp: if (prior_ret < -4095) prior_ret = -4095; and if (err >= 0 || err < -4095) err = -13. Valid LSM denials are always in [-4095, -1] so clamping is a no-op for legitimate values.
fixes_applied.verifier_before: At program exit R0 has smin=2147483648 smax=4294967295 should have been in [-4095, 0]

fixes_applied.issue: socket_connect addrlen if-clamp pattern lost bounds across branches (verifier: R2 unbounded memory access)
fixes_applied.fix: Replaced if (want > 256) want = 256 with want &= (256-1) power-of-2 mask. Verifier tracks bitwise AND natively (0..255). sockaddr_storage is 128 bytes; no real sockaddr reaches 255.
fixes_applied.verifier_before: R2 unbounded memory access, use 'var &= const' or 'if (var < const)'
